question: Which of the following cities of Meghalaya state in India receives the highest rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is **Mawsynram**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mawsynram**​**, which is located in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya**.
 
• It holds the** Guinness World Record for being the wettest place** on Earth.
 
• Mausinram** receives an average annual rainfall of 11,871 millimeters (467.4 inches), **
 
• **which is more than double the rainfall** received by** Cherrapunji, another famous wet place in Meghalaya.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shillong, the capital city of Meghalaya, also receives heavy **rainfall, with an average annual precipitation of 2,987 millimeters (117.6 inches).**
 
• **Jowai is a town located in the Jaintia Hills district of Meghalaya. It receives moderate to heavy rainfall, with an average annual precipitation of 2,716 millimeters **(107 inches).
 
• **Baghmara is a town located in the South Garo Hills district of Meghalaya. It receives relatively lower rainfall compared to other places in Meghalaya, with an average annual precipitation of** 1,500-2,000 millimeters (59-79 inches)
